title: Feature Selective Model Collapse in Diffusion Models: Total Replacement versus Fixed-Budget Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.01318v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Model collapse arises when generative models are trained on synthetic data produced by earlier models. The phenomenon has attracted considerable attention because of its societal and technical implications. However, previous studies have reached seemingly contradictory conclusions: replacing real data with synthetic data causes collapse (Shumailov et al.), yet accumulating real data alongside synthetic data can prevent it. For diffusion models, we study an intermediate regime typical of finite-budget pipelines: all past datasets and the real data are kept, but each new model is trained on a fixed-size sample from this growing pool, so the real fraction vanishes without any data being removed. translated_title: 扩散模型中的特征选择性模型崩溃：完全替换与固定预算训练
translated_abstract: 当生成模型在由先前模型生成的合成数据上进行训练时，就会出现模型崩溃现象。由于其社会和技术层面的影响，该现象引起了广泛关注。然而，先前的研究得出了看似矛盾的结论：用合成数据替换真实数据会导致崩溃（Shumailov等人），而将真实数据与合成数据一同累积则可以防止崩溃。针对扩散模型，我们研究了有限预算流程中一种典型的中间情形：所有历史数据集和真实数据都被保留，但每个新模型都在这个不断增长的数据池中抽取固定大小的样本进行训练，因此真实数据所占比例逐渐消失，而没有任何数据被移除。在二维螺旋数据集以及图像基准数据集（MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和CIFAR-10）上的实验表明，替换协议会如文献中所述导致数据集迅速退化，而固定预算方式仅发生部分退化，并保留了一部分特征。
tldr: 该论文发现在扩散模型中，固定预算训练（保留全部数据但真实数据比例稀释）只会引发部分性的、特征选择性的模型崩溃，而完全替换真实数据则会导致迅速崩溃。
en_tdlr: In diffusion models, fixed-budget training on a growing data pool leads to only partial, feature-selective model collapse, whereas totally replacing real data causes rapid collapse.
